comment: A thin stroke lays the same width on a double resolution layer as on a plain one. On a white 160 by 220 document, seven shallow strokes at 3 degrees go on a plain layer at the top and the same seven on a layer from Layer, New Layer at Double Resolution below: Inked Pen at radius 1.2 and pressure 0.7 and 1.0, Inked Pen at 0.8 and 0.7, Pencil at 2 and 0.7, Paint at 1.2 and 1.0, and Bush and Dry Strokes at radius 6 for their grain, Dry Strokes in the normal blend mode so its colour dodge shows on white. Looks of both at 400 and 800 per cent is kept for review.
